name: Ahmed Hassan
bio: Self-taught. Six months of focused React and Next.js in production — and still going deeper. I write code the way architects draw plans: structure first, then detail, then surface.

contributions.label: Design to Code
contributions.detail: Translated complex Figma systems into semantic, production-ready React and Next.js — zero layout debt handed to QA.

contributions.label: API Integration
contributions.detail: Engineered client-side validation layers and integrated RESTful APIs, eliminating a class of runtime failures.

contributions.label: E-Commerce
contributions.detail: Shipped two production platforms end-to-end: a merchant dashboard and a client storefront on a multi-tenant architecture.
